emails.subject: FW: serious concerns from a member of my team
emails.body_plain:
Hi Sarah,

Forwarding the attached email from one of my engineers. They're alleging behavior from a senior IC on the platform team that may rise to the level of harassment under our policy. I haven't responded yet — wanted you to handle this directly.

The complainant has asked for confidentiality.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed and what I should and shouldn't say to the team in the meantime.

— Marcus

emails.subject: Thank you for the offsite

Just wanted to say from the whole eng team: the offsite last week was incredible. The retreat venue, the activities, the way you ran the open Q&A on the company strategy — best one we've had. Many of us said it's the most we've felt connected to the company since joining.
